Name: (CP) Flowery and not blue grass
Author: GalaxyRobotMods
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/m0Lfzhm.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][center]﻿I [color=#d5a6bd]LOVED[/color] the new Stardew Valley update, except the blue grass BECAUSE IT'S BLUE, BLUE GRASS DOESN'T EXIST AHHH.
So, I got to work and redesigned them to make them more realistic :)
I modified both grasses, both the normal and the blue ones so that there is a clearer difference, as you can see in the images of the mod, both have flowers and a more [b]REALISTIC[/b] color
According to me, the greener the grass, the more nutritious it is, so I simply darkened the grasses and replaced the blue ones.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5IHKjX2.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pQLSmGe.png[/img]﻿
[size=1]Oops, it seems I leaked a butterfly from a mod I work on...[/size]﻿﻿
[color=#c27ba0][size=3]A [/size][size=5]❤[/size][size=3] for you if you have downloaded my mod.
Feel free to comment whatever you want, I will surely answer :3
